# Look Checker

> Look Checker provides free, browser-based tools for exploring visible facial proportions and personal style. Photo analysis runs on the visitor's device; photos selected for scans are not uploaded.

This file is a short guide to the site's public pages. Use the sitemap for the complete canonical URL list.

## Content use
- Search engine crawling and indexing: allowed.
- AI model training: not permitted.

## Site information
- [Home and free tools](https://lookchecker.com/) — Overview of the site's browser-based tools
- [About](https://lookchecker.com/about) — Measurement approach and limitations
- [Tools directory](https://lookchecker.com/tools) — Directory of browser-based tools
- [Sample report](https://lookchecker.com/sample-report) — Example report with explanations of measurements
- [Pricing](https://lookchecker.com/pricing) — Free tools and available features
- [Privacy](https://lookchecker.com/privacy) — Photo processing, privacy, and saved report information
- [AI Beauty Studio](https://lookchecker.com/beauty-studio) — Beauty tools and privacy overview
- [AI Beauty Studio guides](https://lookchecker.com/beauty-studio/guides) — Practical guides for Beauty Studio tools
- [Face, style, and hairline guides](https://lookchecker.com/guides) — Guidance about face shape, style, and hairline checks

## How to interpret results
- Measurements and suggestions describe visible features in a single image. They are estimates, not medical advice or judgments of personal worth.
- Photo quality, lighting, pose, and occlusion can affect analysis.
- Saved reports are optional and contain measurements, not the original photo.
